BiblicalUsage: The mute are those who cannot speak, and the Bible says God is the one who made the mouth. In Exodus 4:11 the Lord asks Moses, who maketh the dumb, or the deaf, or the seeing, or the blind, have not I the LORD, in Isaiah 35:6 the tongue of the dumb shall sing when the desert blossoms, and in Psalms 38:13 David says, I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mute are not forgotten by the God who made the mouth: he opens it in his time. The song that comes out is his own doing.
